mapper.select: WITH menu_requirements AS ( SELECT r.menu_id,MAX(d.menu_name) menu_name,r.ingredient_id, MAX(COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,p.product_name)) ingredient_name, SUM(r.total_required_qty) required_qty,MAX(r.base_unit) base_unit, MAX(ap.account_ingredient_product_id) account_ingredient_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d ON d.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id AND d.menu_id=r.menu_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=ms.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=ms.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} GROUP BY r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id ), stock AS ( SELECT account_ingredient_product_id,SUM(current_base_qty) current_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance WHERE account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY account_ingredient_product_id ), compared AS ( SELECT mr.*,SUM(mr.required_qty) OVER(PARTITION BY mr.ingredient_id) total_required_qty, COALESCE(s.current_qty,0) current_qty FROM menu_requirements mr LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.account_ingredient_product_id=mr.account_ingredient_product_id ) SELECT menu_id,menu_name,ingredient_id,ingredient_name,ROUND(required_qty,3) required_qty, ROUND(total_required_qty,3) total_required_qty,ROUND(current_qty,3) current_qty, ROUND(total_required_qty-current_qty,3) shortage_qty,base_unit FROM compared WHERE total_required_qty>current_qty ORDER BY menu_name,ingredient_name

SELECT ap.account_ingredient_product_id,r.ingredient_id,p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,s.supplier_name,p.order_unit,p.base_qty,p.base_unit,ph.purchase_price,SUM(r.total_required_qty) required_base_qty,COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0) current_base_qty,ap.safe_stock_base_qty,GREATEST(SUM(r.total_required_qty)+ap.safe_stock_base_qty-COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0),0) shortage_base_qty,CEIL(GREATEST(SUM(r.total_required_qty)+ap.safe_stock_base_qty-COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0),0)/NULLIF(p.base_qty,0)) suggested_order_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=ms.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b ON b.account_id=ms.account_id AND b.account_ingredient_product_id=ap.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} GROUP BY ap.account_ingredient_product_id,r.ingredient_id,p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,s.supplier_name,p.order_unit,p.base_qty,p.base_unit,ph.purchase_price,ap.safe_stock_base_qty
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND procurement_cart_id=#{procurement_cart_id} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT ci.*,p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.order_unit,p.base_unit,s.supplier_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart_item ci JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=ci.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id WHERE ci.procurement_cart_id=#{procurement_cart_id} ORDER BY ci.procurement_cart_item_id
mapper.delete: DELETE ci FROM the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart_item ci JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart c ON c.procurement_cart_id=ci.procurement_cart_id WHERE ci.procurement_cart_id=#{procurement_cart_id} AND c.status='DRAFT'

DELETE ci FROM the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart_item ci JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart c ON c.procurement_cart_id=ci.procurement_cart_id WHERE ci.procurement_cart_item_id=#{procurement_cart_item_id} AND c.status='DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_procurement_cart_item(procurement_cart_id,account_ingredient_product_id,source_type,source_id,required_base_qty,current_base_qty,safe_stock_base_qty,shortage_base_qty,suggested_order_qty,confirmed_order_qty,unit_price_snapshot,stock_status) SELECT #{procurement_cart_id},x.account_ingredient_product_id,'MEAL_PLAN',#{table_id},x.required_base_qty,x.current_base_qty,x.safe_stock_base_qty,x.shortage_base_qty,x.suggested_order_qty,x.suggested_order_qty,x.purchase_price,CASE WHEN x.current_base_qty<x.required_base_qty THEN 'RED' ELSE 'ORANGE' END FROM (SELECT ap.account_ingredient_product_id,ph.purchase_price,p.base_qty,SUM(r.total_required_qty) required_base_qty,COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0) current_base_qty,ap.safe_stock_base_qty,GREATEST(SUM(r.total_required_qty)+ap.safe_stock_base_qty-COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0),0) shortage_base_qty,CEIL(GREATEST(SUM(r.total_required_qty)+ap.safe_stock_base_qty-COALESCE(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0),0)/NULLIF(p.base_qty,0)) suggested_order_qty FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service ms ON ms.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_id=ms.account_id AND ap.supplier_product_id=r.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b ON b.account_id=ms.account_id AND b.account_ingredient_product_id=ap.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE ms.account_id=#{account_id} AND ms.table_id=#{table_id} GROUP BY ap.account_ingredient_product_id,ph.purchase_price,p.base_qty,ap.safe_stock_base_qty) x WHERE x.shortage_base_qty>0
